subject: Kingfield County — privacy addendum & FedRAMP-adjacent evidence request
messages:
From: C.A. Wilson <c.wilson@kingfield-county.gov>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: L. Morales <lmorales@kingfield-county.gov>, procurement@kingfield-county.gov
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: County privacy addendum & evidence request

Hi Lauren,

We're preparing our procurement packet for the Kingfield County citizen services modernization project. Attached is our standard privacy addendum (Kingfield_County_Privacy_Addendum_v3.docx). Before we can advance to the evaluation committee, procurement needs:

- A redline of your acceptance/objections to the addendum
- Copy of your SOC 2 report or SOC coverage summary
- Statement of compliance or mapping for SCCs (EU Standard Contractual Clauses) — we have EU residents in the dataset
- Clarification on FedRAMP: the RFQ mentions FedRAMP or FedRAMP-equivalent. Do you have any FedRAMP attestations, or a controls mapping you can share?

Can you confirm by EOD Monday (June 30)? Procurement will route this to county counsel thereafter. We also included IT Security contact L. Morales on this thread for any technical questions.

Attachments: Kingfield_County_Privacy_Addendum_v3.docx (docx)

Thanks,
C.A. Wilson
Procurement Manager
Kingfield County

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: C.A. Wilson <c.wilson@kingfield-county.gov>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, L. Morales <lmorales@kingfield-county.gov>
Date: Wed, 25 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: County privacy addendum & evidence request

Hi C.A.,

Thanks — we received the addendum. Looping in Aditya (sales lead), Marissa (legal), and Markus (security) to prepare a consolidated response and redline. 

Preliminary notes: we can provide our SOC 2 summary and an SCCs mapping. We do not hold a FedRAMP authorization, but we can provide a FedRAMP-adjacent controls mapping and our internal evidence package that aligns to the FedRAMP NIST control sets. I will confirm timeline — aim to get a redline and evidence bundle to you by Monday, Jun 30.

I attached a short SOC 2 summary and a link to our standard DPA template for your review.

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-kingfield

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, C.A. Wilson <c.wilson@kingfield-county.gov>, L. Morales <lmorales@kingfield-county.gov>
Date: Thu, 26 Jun 2025 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: County privacy addendum & evidence request

Hi all,

I reviewed the county addendum. Proposed approach:

- Produce a single redline (KCounty_DPA_redline_2025-06-27.docx) with limited carve-outs: retention and deletion language clarified to reflect our hosted model and retention controls; subprocessors clause will reference our published subprocessor list and 30-day notice for additions; liability caps remain as-is unless county counsel objects.
- Provide SOC 2 summary and the auditor letter under NDA (we can route SOC 2 report via secure link).
- Provide SCCs mapping and a short note about cross-border transfers; where SCCs involve subprocessors, we'll map to our subprocessors list.

Timing: I can turn the redline around by Friday EOD (June 27) if Markus confirms the evidence artifacts he needs included. After redline, we can prepare DocuSign routing for execution.

Marissa
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, C.A. Wilson <c.wilson@kingfield-county.gov>, L. Morales <lmorales@kingfield-county.gov>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: County privacy addendum & evidence request

Marissa — confirmed, I will compile the following evidence:

- SOC 2 summary (attached) and secure link to SOC 2 report under NDA
- CAIQ/SSP pointer (we'll provide the CAIQ export and an SSP excerpt)
- FedRAMP: Redwood is not FedRAMP authorized. We have prepared a "FedRAMP-adjacency summary" which maps our controls to the FedRAMP Moderate baseline and highlights controls that are not applicable in our hosted offering. I am attaching that summary (redwood_fedramp_adjacency_summary.pdf).

Note on hosting: for county-hosted data, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment options; hosted accounts use multi-tenant isolation, and we will include the section that describes our encryption-at-rest and in-transit, KMS integration options, and audit logging capabilities for Dedicated customers.

I will also flag any outstanding evidence items after I export the CAIQ.

Markus Klein
Head of Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_fedramp_adjacency_summary.pdf

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: C.A. Wilson <c.wilson@kingfield-county.gov>, procurement@kingfield-county.gov
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, L. Morales <lmorales@kingfield-county.gov>
Date: Fri, 27 Jun 2025 14:50:00 -0400
Subject: Re: County privacy addendum & evidence request — redline attached

Hi C.A.,

Please find attached our redline to the County Privacy Addendum (KCounty_DPA_redline_2025-06-27.docx) and the security evidence package summary. Key points:

- Redline keeps most language intact; we added clarifying language on retention, subprocessors, and a standard incident response SLA that aligns with our enterprise terms.
- SOC 2 summary attached; full SOC 2 report will be shared via secure link upon execution of an NDA if required by county counsel.
- For FedRAMP: we cannot provide a FedRAMP authorization. We are providing a FedRAMP-adjacency controls mapping (attached) that maps our controls to the FedRAMP Moderate baseline. If the county requires an authorization, we recommend Dedicated/Private deployment with additional contractual controls and a technical review.

Proposed next steps / timeline:
- County counsel to review our redline: by Jul 3 (you indicated procurement counsel will review)
- We will provide CAIQ export and SSP excerpts by Jul 1
- If redline is acceptable, we can route for signature via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/placeholder/kingfield-redwood-nda

Attachments: KCounty_DPA_redline_2025-06-27.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf, redwood_fedramp_adjacency_summary.pdf

Please let me know who from county counsel we should loop in and if there are specific security artifacts they require upfront.

Thanks,
Lauren

From: C.A. Wilson <c.wilson@kingfield-county.gov>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 08:30:00 -0400
Subject: Re: County privacy addendum & evidence request — redline attached

Lauren — thanks for the quick turnaround. County counsel will review your redline next week (target: Jul 3). A few quick clarifications:

- We appreciate the FedRAMP-adjacency mapping; procurement will determine whether that meets the RFQ requirement.
- Please provide the SOC 2 report link (or auditor letter) under NDA and the SCCs mapping document.
- Procurement would prefer DocuSign routing once counsel sign-off is done.

We will circle back after counsel reviews. If counsel wants any tracked changes returned, we will share them.

Best,
C.A. Wilson
Kingfield County Procurement
